digest.top_line: RTOG 0848: adjuvant chemoRT misses OS overall (HR 0.96), but node-negative pts hit 48.1% vs 28.6% 5-yr OS (P-interaction .022).
digest.tldr: Upper GI carried the day, and it's an RT-selection question, not an RT-efficacy one. Modern QA'd chemoRT (50.4 Gy/28 fx, 81% IMRT, central review) is flat after gem-based chemo, but the node-negative subgroup separates sharply. Hypothesis-generating: no subgroup HR in source, and the systemic backbone predates FOLFIRINOX.

sites.intro: One trial, and it reframes adjuvant pancreatic CXRT from whether to whom: IMRT-era delivery with real QA, null overall, node-negative signal only.

studies.name: RTOG 0848
studies.tldr: Adjuvant chemoRT did not improve OS overall (HR 0.96), but node-negative pts gained 48.1% vs 28.6% 5-yr OS.

details.text: 📊 1° EP OS negative: HR 0.96 (90% CI 0.79-1.18), 1-sided P=.38
📐 Median OS 2.6 (90% CI 2.1-3.1) vs 2.3 yrs (2.0-2.6) from step-2 randomization
🔍 Two-step phase IIR/III, N=354 randomized at step 2 after 5 cycles gem-based chemo without progression

details: 🔍 RT was 50.4 Gy/28 fx to tumor bed, pancreatojejunostomy and regional nodes, capecitabine or infusional 5-FU sensitized

details.text: 🔍 RT delivery and QA (why this is not ESPAC-1 radiotherapy)
subdetails: Real-time central plan review before treatment start
Overall QA score per protocol/acceptable in 142/155 treated (92%)
88% of the 153 treated got ≥50 Gy; median dose 50.4 Gy, 28 fx, 38 days
25/180 (14%) never received CXRT, mainly refusal (18 pts)

details.text: 📊 Node-negative subgroup (n=91), the only positive signal

details: ⚠️ Node-negative benefit is a subgroup read, no subgroup HR reported in source text (Fig 3 shows 5-yr rates and P-interaction only)

details.text: ⚠️ Underpowered as reported: 270 OS events vs 316 planned, power 72% for the hypothesized HR 0.76

details: ⚠️ Step-1 chemo was gemcitabine ± erlotinib, zero pts got FOLFIRINOX, so systemic backbone is obsolete

details.text: 🔗 vs ESPAC-1 (adjuvant CXRT detrimental): here 2D split-course, no postop imaging, no QA; 0848 used standardized IMRT-era CXRT with central review
🔗 Patterns of failure: distant-only first failure 38%, local-only 23%, consistent with the codominant failure argument for locoregional therapy

verdict.rationale: Prespecified phase III primary endpoint clearly negative, so routine adjuvant CXRT is not supported; the node-negative interaction (P=.022) is subgroup-level and needs confirmation.
verdict.audience: Resected pancreatic head adenocarcinoma, R0/R1, post 5-6 cycles adjuvant chemo

studies.significance: The RT-relevant read is nodal selection: N0 pts (n=91) reached 48.1% vs 28.6% 5-yr OS with CXRT while N1 (n=263) was flat at 20.9% vs 21.2%, P-interaction .022. Dose was 50.4 Gy/28 fx to bed plus regional nodes with real-time central QA, and grade 4-5 AEs were unchanged (6% v 5%).
studies.monday_clinic: In a resected pancreatic head adenocarcinoma pt who is node-negative and progression-free after adjuvant chemo, this supports discussing CXRT as an option rather than routine practice; it does not support adding CXRT for node-positive disease, and no pt here received FOLFIRINOX.

primary_endpoint.name: Overall survival
primary_endpoint.stat_detail: 90% CI 0.79-1.18, 1-sided P=.38; primary endpoint not met

analysis_sections.label: Design
analysis_sections.body: Two-step, multicenter, open-label phase IIR/III trial (NRG Oncology/RTOG 0848), accrual 2009-2018, analyzed December 2023. **354 pts** randomly assigned 1:1 at step 2, stratified by nodal status, CA19-9, margins and adjuvant systemic treatment. Median follow-up 2.2 yrs overall, **7.4 yrs in survivors**.

analysis_sections.label: Population & inclusion
analysis_sections.body: Curative-intent resection of **pancreatic head** adenocarcinoma with gross total resection documented in the operative note; body/tail excluded on the basis of RTOG 9704. Step 2 required **no progression after 5 cycles** of chemotherapy. 81% pT3, **74% node-positive**, 17% margin-positive, 96% postop CA19-9 ≤90 U/mL.

analysis_sections.label: Regimen
analysis_sections.body: Step 1 was gemcitabine (67%), gemcitabine plus erlotinib (28%), or non-oxaliplatin gemcitabine combinations (5%). **No pt received FOLFIRINOX/mFOLFIRINOX.** Both arms completed a sixth cycle; the CXRT arm then started radiotherapy within 21 days.

analysis_sections.label: Radiotherapy
analysis_sections.body: **50.4 Gy in 28 fractions** to the postoperative tumor bed, pancreatojejunostomy and regional nodes, sensitized with capecitabine (83%) or infusional 5-FU (15%). **81% IMRT**, 19% 3D conformal, all centers IROC-credentialed with **real-time central plan review** before start. Median delivered dose 50.4 Gy over 38 days; 79% had no interruptions.

analysis_sections.label: Endpoints
analysis_sections.body: **Primary: overall survival** from second-step random assignment. Secondary: disease-free survival and CTCAE v4.0 adverse events. Final analysis triggered at the earlier of 316 OS events or all pts having ≥5 yrs potential follow-up.

analysis_sections.label: Results
analysis_sections.body: OS **HR 0.96** (90% CI 0.79-1.18), 1-sided P=.38, with 5-yr OS 23.1% vs 27.9%. DFS **HR 0.82** (0.65-1.03), P=.089. As-treated sensitivity analysis (non-receivers moved to the chemo arm) gave HR 0.98 (0.80-1.20), so refusals do not explain the null.

analysis_sections.label: Safety
analysis_sections.body: **No increase in grade 4-5 AEs** (6% v 5%, P=.68), one grade 5 per arm (hepatic failure, sepsis). Grade 3 AEs rose with CXRT (**38% v 19%**, P<.001), driven by GI toxicity, chiefly diarrhea, and lymphocyte count decrease; grade 3 nonhematologic 22% v 11%, P=.004.

analysis_sections.label: vs leading data
analysis_sections.body: ESPAC-1 found adjuvant CXRT detrimental, but used lower-dose split-course 2D radiotherapy without postoperative imaging or quality assurance, accrued 1994-2000. RTOG 9704 secondary analyses tied **RT protocol deviations to worse survival**, which is the argument for 0848's mandatory real-time review.

analysis_sections.label: Applies to
analysis_sections.body: Represents resected pancreatic head adenocarcinoma progression-free after gemcitabine-based adjuvant chemotherapy. Does not represent pts treated with FOLFIRINOX, neoadjuvant therapy, body/tail primaries, or node-negative plus margin-positive disease (only 10 such pts total).

analysis_sections.label: Limitations
analysis_sections.body: Accrual took nearly 9 yrs and stopped short of target: 270 OS events against 316 planned dropped power to **72%**. Fig 3 reports the nodal subgroups as 5-yr rates and an interaction P value, so a subgroup **HR is not available in the source text**, and node-negative pts are only 26% of the trial.

significance_by_specialty.radonc: Nodal status, not technique, is the gate: N0 pts reached 48.1% vs 28.6% 5-yr OS with 50.4 Gy/28 fx to bed plus regional nodes, while N1 was flat (20.9% v 21.2%). Grade 4-5 toxicity was unchanged (6% v 5%) under mandatory real-time plan review, which removes the ESPAC-1 safety objection.
significance_by_specialty.medonc: The systemic backbone here is obsolete: 67% got gemcitabine alone, 28% gemcitabine plus erlotinib, none FOLFIRINOX, so the null OS says little about CXRT layered onto modern therapy. Distant-only first failure was 38% versus local-only 23%, which is why node positivity swamped any local-therapy effect.

open_questions: Does CXRT add benefit after FOLFIRINOX-based adjuvant or neoadjuvant chemotherapy?
Can SBRT substitute for conventional CXRT in the adjuvant setting?
What is the role of RT for margin-positive resection after neoadjuvant chemotherapy?
